question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **most crucial**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• Imporatnt: Of great significance or value.
 
• Eager: Strongly wanting to do or have something.
 
• Crucial: Of great importance.
 
• Urgent: Requiring immediate action or attention.
 
 
 
• **More **is used when referring to a greater or additional amount or degree.
 
• **Most**. is used when referring to greatest in amount or degree.
 
• We use '**one of**' before '**the most**' in superlative forms to refer to something that is among a group of the most of quality.
 
• So, "**most crucial**" is the correct word choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete passage: *Academic life has (1) become __demanding for students as a result of different internal and external expectations. Teenagers are especially __(2) prone__ to academic stress because they go through so many personal and social changes. As a result, designing effective and efficient __(3) intervention__ solutions requires a thorough understanding of the causes and consequences of academic stress. Exams are one of the **__(4) most crucial __**aspects**__ __**of anyone's life. Exams are stressful for everyone, whether they are students or adults because everyone wants to perform well and no one wants to fail as to avoid (5) __ __ in future.*
